The Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations extend by 12 months the transitional arrangements under Parts 2 and 3 of the Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/589) which enable specified categories of Gibraltar-based firms to provide financial services in the United Kingdom and facilitate the access by similar types of UK-based firms to Gibraltar’s financial services market.

title: The Charities (Russell-Cotes Art Gallery and Museum) Order 2026
summary: This Order gives effect to the scheme (“the scheme”) settled by the Charity Commission for England and Wales in accordance with section 73(1)(a) of the Charities Act 2011 (c. 25) for the administration of the charity known as “Russell-Cotes Art Gallery and Museum” (“the Charity”). Prior to the Order coming into force, the Charity was governed by section 57 of the Bournemouth Borough Council Act 1985 (c. v) and “the Governing Documents” as defined in paragraph 1 of the Schedule to the Order. title: The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (c. 20) (“the 2026 Act”). These are the fifth commencement regulations made under the 2026 Act.

title: The Export Control (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Export Control Order 2008 (S.I. 2008/3231) (“the 2008 Order”) and assimilated Council Regulation (EC) No 428/2009 of 5 May 2009 setting up a Community regime for the control of exports, transfer, brokering and transit of dual-use items (Recast) (EUR 2009/428) (“the assimilated Dual-Use Regulation”).

title: The Bus Franchising Assessment (Approved Persons) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify types of persons as an approved person for the purposes of section 123D of and paragraph 4(7) of Schedule 9A to the Transport Act 2000 (c. 38). Section 123D of that Act provides that an independent approved person must prepare a report on the assessment of a proposed franchising scheme before a franchising authority or authorities can proceed with the scheme. title: The Contracts for Difference (Electricity Supplier Obligations) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations relate to the levy arrangements that support the Contracts for Difference scheme established under Chapter 2 of Part 2 of the Energy Act 2013 (c. 32) (“the 2013 Act”). Government funds can be paid into the scheme to reduce the amount of the levy. These Regulations amend the Contracts for Difference (Electricity Supplier Obligations) Regulations 2014 so as to broaden the circumstances in which that can happen. title: The Control of Asbestos (Amendment etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 (S.I. 2012/632) (“the 2012 Regulations”) to introduce a requirement that the assessment of the cleanliness of the premises, where work relating to asbestos has been carried out, is undertaken by a person who is appointed independently of the person who carried out the work relating to asbestos on those premises.

title: The Customs (Tariff and Miscellaneous Amendments) (No. 7) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2 amends the definition of “the authorised use document” in regulation 32(2) of the Customs (Special Procedures and Outward Processing) (EU Exit) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/1249) to refer to a new version of that document. The new version of that document introduces authorised use measures to reduce the rate of import duty on nine commodity codes relating to steel goods used in the manufacture of bright bar, a precision-finished steel bar product, and wire. title: The Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (Commencement No. 5) and English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the fifth commencement regulations made under the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34) (“the 2025 Act”) and the fifth commencement regulations made under the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23) (“the 2026 Act”). These Regulations bring into force provisions relating to spatial development strategies.

title: The Data-gathering (Ongoing Data: Interest and Payment Card Transactions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision requiring persons of specified description to provide specified data to His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs (“HMRC”) on an ongoing basis.

title: Sovereign Grant Act 2026
summary: An Act to specify the amount of the Sovereign Grant for the financial year 2027-28 and the percentage of the income account net surplus of the Crown Estate to be used by the Royal Trustees to determine the amount of the Sovereign Grant in subsequent financial years; to confer a duty and a power on the Treasury to specify the amount of the Sovereign Grant in subsequent financial years in certain circumstances; and for connected purposes.

title: The Mesothelioma Lump Sum Payments (Conditions and Amounts) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: Under the Child Maintenance and Other Payments Act 2008 (c. 6) (“the 2008 Act”), lump sum payments may be made to certain persons with diffuse mesothelioma or their dependants. The Mesothelioma Lump Sum Payments (Conditions and Amounts) Regulations 2008 (S.I. 2008/1963) (“the 2008 Regulations”) set out the conditions to be met for a lump sum payment to be made, along with the rates of payment.

title: The Pneumoconiosis etc. (Workers’ Compensation) (Payment of Claims) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: Under the Pneumoconiosis etc. (Workers’ Compensation) Act 1979 (c. 41) (“the 1979 Act”), lump sum payments may be made to certain persons disabled by a disease to which the Act applies, or to dependants of persons who were so disabled before they died. The Pneumoconiosis etc. (Workers’ Compensation) (Payment of Claims) Regulations 1988 (S.I. 1988/668) (“the 1988 Regulations”) prescribe the amount of payments to be made under the 1979 Act, according to the person’s age and level of disablement.

title: The Energy Performance of Buildings (Scotland) Amendment Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Energy Performance of Buildings (Scotland) Regulations 2008 and the Energy Performance of Buildings (Scotland) Regulations 2025.

title: The Transport and Works (Applications, Objections, Listed Buildings, Inquiries and Decisions Procedure) (England and Wales) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend, subject to the transitional provisions in regulation 1, the Transport and Works (Inquiries Procedure) Rules 2004 (S.I. 2004/2018) (“the 2004 Rules”), the Transport and Works (Applications and Objections Procedure) (England and Wales) Rules 2006 (S.I. 2006/1466) (“the 2006 Rules”) and the Transport and Works Applications (Listed Buildings, Conservation Areas and Ancient Monuments Procedure) Regulations 1992 (“the 1992 Regulations”).

title: The Transport Infrastructure (Fees) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision for prescribed public authorities to charge fees for services provided in connection with certain transport infrastructure projects. They are made under powers inserted into the Highways Act 1980 (c. 66) (“the 1980 Act”) and the Transport and Works Act 1992 (c. 42) (“the 1992 Act”) by the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34).

title: The Mobile Homes (Written Statement) (Scotland) Regulations 2026
summary: The Mobile Homes Act 1983 (“the 1983 Act”) applies to all agreements under which persons are entitled to station a mobile home on a protected site and occupy it as their only or main residence. Section 1(2) of the 1983 Act provides that before such an agreement is entered into, the site owner must give to the proposed occupier of the mobile home a written statement. title: The First-tier Tribunal for Scotland (Transfer of Functions and Members of the Police Appeals Tribunal) Amendment Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the First-tier Tribunal for Scotland (Transfer of Functions and Members of the Police Appeals Tribunal) Regulations 2025 (“the 2025 Regulations”).

title: The Fuel Poverty (Targets, Definition and Strategy) (Scotland) Act 2019 (Commencement No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations commence section 18(3) and (4) of the Fuel Poverty (Targets, Definition and Strategy) (Scotland) Act 2019. Section 18(3) and 18(4) makes consequential amendments to section 89 and 95 of the Housing (Scotland) Act 2001 to amend the definition of fuel poverty.
